findings.title: Same-brand different-product label could mutate wrong item
findings.summary: A matching brand did not prove product identity; a different product from the same brand could pass correlation.

findings.title: Actionable label invitation could be sent without durable continuation
findings.summary: Pending-operation persistence failure did not prevent the final reply from inviting a later label upload.

findings.title: Concurrency risk family was marked not applicable
findings.summary: The CRITICAL risk package omitted concurrency-atomicity despite an explicit concurrent-response requirement.
